description: Adding a speech clip: capture permission, duplicates by client id, limits.
precondition: Meeting in progress; participant who may capture.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker is configured and free; the sentence holds words.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: clientClipId new, startedAt within 2 minutes of now, durationMs 5,000, audio/wav audio.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318) with the saved sentence: the transcribed text, StartedAt from the browser clock, DurationMs 5,000, audio stored with waveform peaks.
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: The same sentence was already stored (its response was lost on the way back).
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: the same clientClipId again with new audio bytes.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318) with the already stored sentence; nothing is transcribed or stored again.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The worker hears only silence (a cough, a door).
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid audio that transcribes to no words.
cases.return: Success with no data (204); nothing is stored.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress.
cases.inputs: upload: clientClipId empty.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG319) with an error on clipId: “Thiếu mã câu nói.”; nothing is stored.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress.
cases.inputs: upload: durationMs 0.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG319) with an error on durationMs: “Một câu dài từ 1 ms đến 60 giây.”; nothing is stored.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker is configured and free.
cases.inputs: upload: durationMs 60,000 with matching audio.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318); a sentence of exactly 60 seconds is accepted.
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress.
cases.inputs: upload: durationMs 60,001.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG319) with an error on durationMs: “Một câu dài từ 1 ms đến 60 giây.”; nothing is stored.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress.
cases.inputs: upload: audio of 0 bytes.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG319) with an error on audio: “Câu nói không có âm thanh.”; nothing is stored.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: The meeting ends after the capture check, before the sentence is stored.
cases.inputs: meetingId of an Online meeting that just ended 8 days after its end; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: NotCapturing (409, MSG320); the audio file written for the sentence is deleted.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker is not configured.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: EngineUnavailable (503, MSG312); nothing is stored and no audio file is written.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker's slots are all busy for 30 seconds.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: EngineUnavailable (503, MSG312); the browser keeps the sentence and sends it again later.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker fails on this sentence.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: EngineUnavailable (503, MSG312); nothing is stored.
cases.log: Warning log 'The speech worker could not transcribe a clip'.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The disk is full, so the audio cannot be kept.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid audio/wav audio.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318) with the sentence stored without audio (peaks null); the words are kept because the minutes are written from them.
cases.log: Error log 'Could not store the audio of a speech clip'.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The speech worker is configured and free.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid audio/webm audio.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318); the audio is stored as .webm with no waveform peaks (only WAV draws a waveform).
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The worker returns a text longer than 8,000 characters.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318); the stored text is cut to 8,000 characters.
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The browser clock is 10 minutes ahead of the server.
cases.inputs: upload: startedAt 10 minutes in the future.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318); StartedAt falls back to the server time (browser clocks further than 2 minutes off are not trusted).
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting that ended 3 days ago, with ActualEndedAt set.
The sentence was said during the meeting and kept on the device.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: startedAt during the meeting, valid.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318); the sentence is accepted and its StartedAt is kept (no later than when the meeting ended).
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: The same sentence is sent twice at once; the other request stores it first.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: the same clientClipId in two concurrent requests.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318) with the other request's stored sentence; only one row is kept.
cases.exception: UniqueConflictException caught; the staged change is discarded.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: Online meeting in status InProgress; the actor is an active participant.
The database fails while storing the sentence.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: the participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: SaveFailed (503, MSG304); the audio file written for the sentence is deleted.
cases.log: Error log 'Failed to store a speech clip'.

preconditions: The database fails while checking the capture permission.
cases.inputs: meetingId; actorId: a participant; upload: valid.
cases.return: SaveFailed (503, MSG304); nothing is transcribed.
cases.log: Error log 'Failed to check speech capture for {MeetingId}'.
